words.wash_st: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount of every covered short-term sale with a wash-sale loss adjustment (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
words.wash_lt: Have you recorded the wash-sale loss adjustment amount of every covered long-term sale with a wash-sale loss adjustment (a loss disallowed because you bought the same investment within 30 days before or after the sale) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
words.only_box2a: Is it true that you had no capital gains in 2025 other than capital gain distributions in box 2a of Form 1099-DIV, and that you did not sell stock, funds or other property in 2025 (even a sale with no gain or loss)?
words.sli: Is someone else claiming you (or your spouse, on a joint return) as a dependent on their 2025 return?

fact_titles.exception1.only-box2a-capital-gains: Exception 1 component C1 (ADR-0050): whether the return's only capital gains are Form 1099-DIV box-2a capital-gain distributions and the filer sold no stock, funds or other property in 2025, including a sale with no gain or loss (Form 1040 instructions, line 7a: "If you sold a capital asset ... you must complete and attach Form 8949 and Schedule D"). Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.
fact_titles.sli-scope.not-claimed-as-dependent: Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component (legal zero, not a block): neither the filer nor, on a joint return, the filer's spouse is claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's 2025 return (Form 1040 instructions, Schedule 1 line 21: "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's ... 2025 tax return"; Pub. 970 p.33). An actual claim, not whether someone could claim. Filer-level. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts neither is claimed and the route proceeds; no asserts the filer or, on a joint return, the spouse IS claimed -- the law's own definite $0 for this return, not missing information and not a block.

titles.taxpayer-over-65: Taxpayer was born before January 2, 1961. A person reaches age 65 on the day before the 65th birthday. A taxpayer who was born before January 2, 1961 but died in 2025 before reaching age 65 is not included.
titles.taxpayer-blind: Taxpayer was totally blind as of December 31, 2025, or has a statement certified by an eye doctor that the taxpayer cannot see better than 20/200 in the better eye with glasses or contact lenses, or that the field of vision is 20 degrees or less.
titles.spouse-over-65: Spouse was born before January 2, 1961. A person reaches age 65 on the day before the 65th birthday. A spouse who was born before January 2, 1961 but died in 2025 before reaching age 65 is not included.
titles.spouse-blind: Spouse was totally blind as of December 31, 2025, or has a statement certified by an eye doctor that the spouse cannot see better than 20/200 in the better eye with glasses or contact lenses, or that the field of vision is 20 degrees or less.
